name: Grilled cù kỳ
summary: Cù kỳ nướng is the grilled animal, not the noodle bowl. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, names it among the first plates of a Hạ Long seafood meal, beside sò huyết, ốc, ghẹ, and bề bề.
origin: Hạ Long. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015. The noodle is a separate plate.
howToEat: Grilled, as a small plate before the soup. The 9 Jul 2015 account does not give a marinade.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The ordinary seafood meal. Not a named stall.
seoTitle: Cu ky nuong — grilled, not the noodle bowl
